Dear Jabor

On 6 Dec 2018, at 13:13, Jabor Y.

> wrote:

Dear Sir,
Apologies for the delay in responding back to you.
18 Dec, is our National day and we plan to depart immediately after the ceremony. However, we do not know
yet the closing time of the ceremony. We will have an idea towards next week and will schedule our trip
accordingly.
In principle 18 / 19 Dec, still stands good for our meeting and towards next week we will be able to give you a
confirmation.
Warm regards,
Jabor
On Sun, Nov 25, 2018 at 2:27 PM Jabor Al Thani

> wrote:

Dear Sir,

We very well understand your busy schedule and your concerns on the regional and global front.

December, 18 / 19, looks quite good for the meeting. Allow us a couple of days and we shall get back with an
appropriate time and place for the meeting.

With our very best regards,

Jabor Al Thani

EFTA01014169

 From: ehbarak (mac):
Sent: 23 November 2018 03:04 AM

To: labor Al Thani
Cc: J
Subject: Re: Touch Base J.

Hi Jabor
Thx again for your prompt response.
I'm really enthusiast about the coming meeting with HH HBJ.
So many fascinating and disturbing events following each other on the global and our regional arenas. And so
much to discuss.
I've tried my best to change my schedules and meet before Nov 30, but unfortunately failed.
I'll be happy to come to London on Dec 18 or 19 (or to Paris if that's much better for you) and have a
meeting. Hopefully a first one to be followed by many more.
Looking forward for your response.
Best regards to His Highness,
Best
Ehud Barak
Sent from my iPhone

We will be returning back to Qatar, by 30 November. However, will be back in Europe, again by 18 December. We

Feel free to let us know your thoughts.

Best regards,
